tagline: 柯达便携相机，1999 年发布
description: 柯达于1999年推出的便携相机。配备Auto-focusing motorized all-glass 28 mm f/3.5 Ektanar。快门速度Programmed, full-aperture shutter 1/4-1/500 seconds。使用APS film。感光度1.3 -18 ft (0.4- 5.5 m)。130 zones, active AF。

specs.镜头: Auto-focusing motorized all-glass 28 mm f/3.5 Ektanar
specs.取景器: Real image with C, H, & P format display
specs.重量: 4.2 oz. (120 g) without film or battery
specs.英文简介: The Advantix T500 is an auto-focus compact camera for the APS film system.
